category: real-time OSINT and geopolitical intelligence dashboard
one_liner: Streams OSINT, markets, transport, cyber and disaster signals onto a live map with APIs, alerts and AI briefings.
use_cases: monitor breaking conflicts and unrest on a live map
verify a breaking event against attributed sources
track shipping chokepoint disruption and vessel flows
connect geopolitical events to market and commodity moves
screen country instability and resilience scores
follow aviation, maritime, cyber, outage, fire and disaster signals together
plan shipment routes around chokepoints and country-risk exposure
run disruption scenarios for conflicts, weather, sanctions and tariffs
feed geopolitical and market data into applications through REST APIs, SDKs or an MCP server
differentiators: Free core dashboard with no signup required.
Open-source platform licensed AGPL-3.0-only, with official thin clients under MIT.
Combines 460 news and OSINT feeds from 762 attributed providers on one map.
Includes 58 map layer types across geopolitics, markets, shipping, aviation, infrastructure, cyber and natural events.
Provides REST API, MCP server, CLI and SDKs for npm, Python, Ruby and Go.
Publishes country instability and resilience scoring, including resilience rankings for 170 countries.
signature_terms: By the time it's news, you already knew
AI agents can drive the dashboard
